messages:
oncall-bot: :warning: PAGING: multiple nodes NotReady in eu-west inference pool (hosts 22-25). Alert: pod OOMKill x5, kubelet restarts x3. Please acknowledge and follow runbook.

alex: Acknowledged. Observed spike in 502/504 from EU-W at 11:03. Root symptoms look like kubelet exits and kernel OOMs on several nodes. Tagging @jamal for lead.

jamal: Taking lead. Immediate checklist: 1) identify unhealthy hosts, 2) cordon/drain sequentially, 3) route high-SLA tenants to fallback pool, 4) capture logs. Any objections?

maria: No objections. Quick data: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep eu-west` shows host-22/23 NotReady. host-24 Ready but kubelet flapping. dmesg on host-23 shows repeated "Out of memory: Kill process 27894 (containerd-shim)" and multiple `NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus` messages.

emily: Can we check if there was a scheduled batch job or heavy cache build around 10:50? Also check node-exporter memory spike graphs.

ops-bot: Autoscaler attempted to acquire 2 a100 nodes at 11:05 and received CapacityError: no-capacity-in-zone. Fallback candidates: smaller gpu.xp family or cross-region eu-central reserved.

jamal: Ok plan: cordon host-22/23 to stop scheduling; drain host-22 and reboot. If pods don't come back due to driver issues, we'll re-route high-SLA traffic to eu-central reserved.

alex: Also add temporary circuit-breaker on model-large for eu-west to reduce retries and cache pressure.

maria: Draining host-22 now. Some GPU-bound pods stuck with CrashLoopBackOff because they require node taint `gpu:reserved=true` and the available nodes don't have that taint. Two options: temporarily remove the taint requirement for these pods (risky) or migrate traffic to reserved pool in eu-central. I prefer migration.

jamal: Agreed. Ops, please flip routing for tenants fintech-prod and payments-core to eu-central reserved pool. Keep lower-tier traffic on reduced capacity with quantized fallback.

ops-bot: Routing change done at 11:14: fintech-prod -> eu-central-reserved, payments-core -> eu-central-reserved. Canary at 5% then 100%. Health checks passing for fintech-prod after shift.

emily: On host-22 after reboot, kubelet starts but reports "failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to setup sandbox" and `nvidia: module not loaded`. Running `sudo modprobe nvidia` and `sudo systemctl restart kubelet` made pods recover.

maria: Found one model runtime that OOMKilled due to an unbounded in-memory cache. Identified container logs with repeated "java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space" for model-worker-47. Increased JVM Xmx to 4g and added helm chart resource limits. Restarting pod.

alex: Good. Also note: node-agent logs show no node-problem-detector event. Let's enable nvidia-driver failure alert rule and auto-taint nodes when kernel reports GPU off-bus to avoid scheduling.

sre-rotation: I'll take the action item. Short-term: add node-problem-detector job to detect GPU failures and taint nodes; medium-term: add autoscaler fallback to alternate instance families; long-term: improve model-runtime defaults to include memory caps.

ops-bot: Incident metrics: error rate in eu-west peaked at 20% at 11:06, after routing changes for high-SLA customers dropped to 6% at 11:22. Overall baseline restored at 11:35.

jamal: host-23 rebooted and recovered with driver reload. Re-scheduled pods. One pod still OOMKilled (model-worker-47) until resource limit applied. Confirmed no customer data exposure. Support tickets increased 3x for eu-west during window.

maria: Quick commands used:
```
kubectl cordon host-22
kubectl drain host-22 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
ssh host-22 sudo modprobe nvidia && sudo systemctl restart kubelet
kubectl apply -f model-worker-47-resources-patch.yaml
```

jamal: Status page updated: short message about partial degradation in eu-west and mitigations taken, ETA for close: 12:00. Notifying affected accounts in the priority list.

emily: Post-incident follow-ups: 1) add node-agent auto-reload for nvidia modules; 2) add node-problem-detector tainting rule for GPU-offline; 3) add autoscaler fallback option in infra config; 4) ensure older helm charts include `resources.limits.memory` for model workers.

sre-rotation: I'll schedule postmortem and own the follow-ups. Please drop logs into the incident doc: `/incidents/2026-04-07-eu-west-node-flap/` (kubelet-host-22.log, dmesg-host-23.log, model-worker-47.log).

ops-team: Confirming mitigations stable. No further NotReady nodes after last reboot. Closing alert at 11:38. :white_check_mark:

jamal: Wrapping up handoff. I'll produce a short incident write-up, include timeline, customers impacted, and the list of mitigations and next steps. Assigning owners: @sre-rotation (node detector), @maria (helm chart fix), @emily (autoscaler fallback).

alex: Thanks all. If anything regresses, reopen and ping the rotation. End of thread."
